subject: Re: [AMBER] Installation of Amber on Ubuntu 22.04

messages.author: David A Case
messages.body:
On Fri, Nov 08, 2024, 袁浩亮 via AMBER wrote:
>
>      I have download the latest Amber24 and AmberTools24.
>
>      I'm going to install them to my new workstation with the OS Ubuntu 22.04.
>
>      I would like to ask that if you have the procedures for installing because I'm not familia with this operating system.
Step by step instructions are in the Amber 2024 Reference Manual, Section 2.1.
You can get the latest version of this manual here:
https://ambermd.org/doc12/Amber24.pdf
Note that step 2 of the procedure sends you here:
https://ambermd.org/InstUbuntu.php
which has specific information about Ubuntu.
...good luck...dac
